components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for a decisive local workbench operation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gs-component-button-primary-background); color: var(--gs-component-button-primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gs-component-button-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--gs-component-button-primary-pressed); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action with an essential boundary and quiet hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--gs-component-button-secondary-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gs-component-button-secondary-background); color: var(--gs-component-button-secondary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--gs-component-button-secondary-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action that reveals an inset hover surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--gs-semantic-text-secondary); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--gs-semantic-surface-inset); color: var(--gs-semantic-text-primary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Repository Blue action for a selected or navigational context.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gs-semantic-selection-text); color: var(--gs-semantic-text-inverse); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--gs-semantic-selection-border); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action with a labelled error surface and text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--gs-semantic-feedback-error-text); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gs-semantic-feedback-error-surface); color: var(--gs-semantic-feedback-error-text); font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--gs-semantic-feedback-error-surface); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text field for branch names, paths, and other repository values.
components.css: .ds-field { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--gs-component-field-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gs-component-field-background); color: var(--gs-component-field-text); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--gs-component-field-placeholder); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--gs-component-field-border); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--gs-component-field-focus-border); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--gs-component-field-focus-ring); } .ds-field:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--gs-component-field-disabled-background); opacity: 0.65; }

components.name: Success Badge
components.description: Text-labelled success status for checks and completed states.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--gs-semantic-feedback-success-text); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gs-component-badge-success-background); color: var(--gs-component-badge-success-text); font: 500 11px/16px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-badge-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.description: Elevated confirmation surface above the local-first workbench shell.

components.css: .ds-dialog-layer { position: relative; min-height: 220px; } .ds-dialog-layer::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(20, 24, 32, 0.34); } .ds-dialog { position: relative; width: min(100% - 32px, 512px); margin: 32px auto; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--gs-semantic-border-essential); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--gs-semantic-surface-content); color: var(--gs-semantic-text-primary); box-shadow: var(--gs-semantic-elevation-large); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 32px 8px 0; font: 500 20px/1.25 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; color: var(--gs-semantic-text-secondary); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-close { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--gs-semantic-text-secondary); font-size: 20px; } .ds-dialog-close:hover { background: var(--gs-semantic-surface-inset); color: var(--gs-semantic-text-primary); } .ds-dialog-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gs-component-button-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Git Stacks is a quiet, precise desktop workbench for navigating branches, stacks, pull requests, changes, history, and stashes. The system adapts the cool-gray canvas, rounded white work surfaces, ink-colored primary actions, and restrained blue selection of the Journey CRM Dashboard reference into a local-first Git and GitHub product. Journey is a visual and material reference only: Git Stacks does not introduce CRM stages, analytics cards, or a web client.

The visual language is intentionally restrained. Workbench Ink makes primary actions and navigation feel decisive; Repository Blue keeps links, selection, focus, checked-out state, and stack edges legible without turning the whole interface into a status field. Rounded surfaces and quiet tonal layers organize dense repository information while preserving the desktop workbench hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-gray workspace canvas with white content surfaces and inset grouping surfaces.
Workbench Ink primary actions and navigation with Repository Blue selection and links.
Independent, text-labelled Git states for selection, checked-out state, pull-request lifecycle, checks, review, restacks, and diffs.
Compact information density for branch, pull-request, stash, history, and diff rows.
Local-first, keyboard-accessible, operation-safe behavior with no external font or network dependency.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every selection, checked-out branch, pull-request lifecycle, checks state, review decision, restack requirement, and diff role has an explicit text or icon meaning. Unknown or unavailable GitHub data uses the neutral unknown role and an explicit unavailable label; it is never represented as none, zero, or passing.

rules.name: The Essential Boundary Rule
rules.body: semantic.border.decorative is for decorative dividers only. Inputs, controls, and meaningful graphics that need a non-text boundary use semantic.border.essential or semantic.focus.ring.

rules.name: The Code Is Monospace Rule
rules.body: Use the system monospace stack for code, paths, refs, and OIDs; use the system sans stack for interface copy. No external font is loaded and no font files are copied from chat artifacts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Use a shadow only when a component is floating, transient, or deliberately elevated; do not use decorative shadows to imply Git state.

dos: Do use Workbench Ink for primary actions and navigation, with Repository Blue reserved for links, selection, focus, and meaningful identity accents.
Do keep selection, checked-out state, pull-request lifecycle, checks, review, restacks, and diff additions/deletions/hunks independent and explicitly labelled.
Do use the 4px spacing rhythm, 36/44px controls, 44/56px rows, and the defined 12/16/24/999px radius scale where the current component architecture consumes them.
Do use semantic.border.essential for essential boundaries, semantic.focus.ring for keyboard focus, and text/icon descriptions alongside every Git status.
Do use npm run tokens:generate followed by npm run tokens:check after editing src/renderer/src/design-system/tokens.json; never hand-edit generated tokens.css.
Do keep the renderer local-first, preserve the sandbox/preload/IPC/CSP boundary, and retain busy-state text when reduced motion removes animation.
donts: Don't globally replace --accent with ink; selection, links, checked-out state, and stack graphics remain Repository Blue, while merged pull requests remain violet.
Don't use color alone for status, lifecycle, review, checks, unknown/unavailable data, or diff meaning.
Don't use decorative semantic.border.decorative dividers as a substitute for essential control boundaries or meaningful graphics.
Don't add external font loading, font files from chat artifacts, a second manually maintained palette, CRM runtime behavior, or new Git/IPC/navigation semantics.
Don't claim that every existing component consumes all density or radius tokens; migrate each consumer as its owning issue changes it.
Don't use shadows to imply Git state; reserve depth for floating, transient, or elevated surfaces.
